domains.label: Maxey0 System
domains.desc: How Maxey0 itself runs (the system that feeds the Human0 app): one topic, Maxey0.

domains.label: Foundations
domains.desc: The basic dimensions every task has: where it is (location, environment), when (time), what holds (state), what it is part of (systems) and what it runs on (infrastructure).

domains.label: Work Domains
domains.desc: Areas of applied work a user brings a task from.

domains.label: Finance
domains.desc: Everything needed to understand financial activity, from accounting and corporate finance to offerings, markets, instruments, crypto, funds, regulation and data. Context only: nothing here executes a transaction.

domains.label: Academic Disciplines
domains.desc: Fields of study, one topic per field.

topics.label: Maxey0
topics.desc: How Maxey0 itself runs: orchestration of MaxeyN agents (loops, superposition), runtime infrastructure, message contracts, Structured Context Windows, tiered memory and the OKF knowledge graph, latent space, policy gates and evaluation, and structured reasoning with claim verification.

topics.label: Environments and Deployment
topics.desc: Where software is built and runs: development environments, local, cloud and edge targets, endpoints and addresses, and promotion from development to production. Includes the Human0 development environment (name to be decided), an MCP app that would deploy a development server in one step.

topics.label: Infrastructure
topics.desc: What software runs on: compute and runtimes, networking and DNS, infrastructure as code, containers and orchestration, and CI/CD pipelines.

topics.label: Location and Place
topics.desc: Where something is: geographic coordinates, place names, addresses, distances and routes on Earth, and the regions and jurisdictions that a place falls in. Physical location; digital locations (where software runs) are in Environments and Deployment.

topics.label: State
topics.desc: What holds at a time and place: state models and state machines, persistence and storage, snapshots, versions and provenance, and keeping copies consistent.

topics.label: Systems
topics.desc: Systems in general: systems thinking and feedback, boundaries and interfaces, modeling and architecture, reliability and failure modes, and emergence.

topics.label: Time
topics.desc: When something happens: clocks, time zones and timestamps, calendars and scheduling, durations and deadlines, and ordering of events.

topics.label: Coding Agents
topics.desc: Coding agents: the harness and tool loop, code generation and editing, repository understanding, verification, review, sandboxing, orchestration and evaluation.

topics.label: Data
topics.desc: Data work end to end: modelling and schemas, ingestion and pipelines, warehouses and analytics engineering, data quality, catalogues and lineage, exploration and visualisation, streaming, and dataset preparation for machine learning.

topics.label: Drones
topics.desc: Drones (uncrewed aircraft): platforms and makers, airframe types, applications, autopilots, payloads, regulation and mission data. Drones are aerial robots; the Robotics topic holds the shared control and navigation skills. Includes planetary and extreme-environment UAVs (Moon, Mars).

topics.label: Governance
topics.desc: Governance of agent systems and the organisations that run them: policy, risk, compliance frameworks, access and approval, audit and provenance, privacy, safety cases and incident accountability. Extends the base Governance topic.

topics.label: Human Language
topics.desc: Human languages as a subject and a working domain: sounds, words, grammar, meaning, vocabulary, translation and localisation, writing systems and Unicode, computational linguistics, and language variation and learning.

topics.label: JobSeeker
topics.desc: Job seeking end to end: target roles, resume and profile, search, applications, interviews and offers.

topics.label: Knowledge
topics.desc: Knowledge management for people and agents: ontologies and taxonomies, knowledge graphs, entity resolution, metadata, curation and quality, retrieval and question answering, documentation and sharing. Extends the base Knowledge topic, which held only Knowledge Graph.

topics.label: Mapping
topics.desc: Mapping: map types, dimensions, coordinate systems, survey methods, SLAM (simultaneous localization and mapping), spatial data and web mapping.

topics.label: Marketing
topics.desc: Marketing: strategy and positioning, content and social, search, email and lifecycle, paid media, and measurement.

topics.label: Observability
topics.desc: Observability of software and agent systems: metrics, logs and traces, instrumentation, dashboards, alerts and SLOs, agent and LLM tracing, root-cause debugging, drift and regression monitoring, incidents and capacity. Extends the base Observability topic, which held Observability and Evaluation.

topics.label: Programming Languages

topics.label: Protocol
topics.desc: Protocols and interfaces between agents, tools and services: MCP servers and clients, agent-to-agent protocols, API design, schemas and contracts, authentication flows, transports, versioning and conformance testing. Extends the base Protocol topic, which held I/O Contract and Protocol.

topics.label: Real Estate and Property

topics.label: Reasoning

topics.label: Research
